seasonRead.headline: 2018–19: The forward field opens up
paragraphs: The 2018–19 model learned 6 forward styles. Perimeter Skill Scorer led with 174 of 476 forwards (36.6%), followed by High-Volume Playmaking Scorer at 23.1%.
The leading profile reaches only 36.6%, and 23.1% of forwards sit outside the top three. Across six learned styles, the model shows several viable identities rather than one dominant lane.

seasonRead.headline: 2018–19: Puck-moving control leads a tiered blue line
paragraphs: The 2018–19 model learned 5 defense styles. Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman led with 101 of 257 defenders (39.3%), followed by Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman at 27.2%.
Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman leads at 39.3%, followed by Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman at 27.2%. The last two profiles share 8.6%, creating a clear top tier with a small tail.
